name: Wink Saigon Centre, Unscripted by Hyatt
short_description: A 237-room boutique hotel on Nguyen Binh Khiem in District 1, with a Wink Kitchen street-food concept and 24/7 gym, laundromat, and co-working space.
ai_summary: Wink Saigon Centre sits on Nguyen Binh Khiem Street in a hip pocket of District 1, close to the Botanical Gardens and downtown Ho Chi Minh City's main sights, and joined World of Hyatt through the December 2025 Wink Hotels partnership under the Unscripted by Hyatt brand. The 237-room property leans into Wink's boutique-lifestyle formula: a Wink Kitchen street-food concept, 24/7 gym, laundromat and convenience store, a co-working space, and in-room spa services. Reviews are notably split -- many guests call it a stylish, well-priced stay with friendly staff and spotless housekeeping, while a vocal minority report significant service breakdowns, so it's worth reading recent reviews before booking.

core_facts.address: 75 Nguyen Binh Khiem, Tan Dinh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000, Vietnam
elite_benefits: Complimentary full breakfast daily for World of Hyatt Globalist Elite members at properties without a dedicated club lounge, per World of Hyatt program terms
Room upgrades for Explorist and Globalist Elite members, subject to availability
Late check-out until 4pm for Globalist Elite members, subject to availability

24/7 gym, laundromat, convenience store, and a co-working space

Some guests report billing discrepancies or unexpected charges at checkout

faqs.question: Where is Wink Saigon Centre located?
faqs.answer: On Nguyen Binh Khiem Street in District 1, near the Botanical Gardens, a hip pocket of downtown Ho Chi Minh City within reach of the city's main sights.

faqs.question: Are reviews of Wink Saigon Centre consistent?
faqs.answer: Not entirely -- most guests describe a stylish, well-priced stay with friendly, attentive staff, but a vocal minority report significant service breakdowns, so it's worth checking recent reviews close to your travel dates before booking.
